metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:scope: One final training transition per selected user; in-sample, fixed positive and one fixed uniform training-history-excluded negative. Historical repeats of the target are retained.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:features: Oldest interactions truncated; survivors right-aligned with left padding; baseline absolute slots 0..maxlen-1; final slot scored. BxD output requires explicit final_BD declaration.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_alignment: Mean off-diagonal normalized cosine of up to 2048 seed-42 sampled nonpadding embeddings, excluding zero norms. mapped_alignment=(cosine+1)/2; zero cosine maps to 0.5. Neither metric establishes collapse or recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:intact: User means of fixed positive-minus-negative margin, margin<0, margin<0.5, and exact ties; p10 is the inverse empirical CDF over users. These two-candidate statistics are not HR@10. The 0.5 cutoff is descriptive, not calibrated.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:baseline_margin: Intact positive-minus-fixed-negative margin restricted to the successful user/draw tuples of this condition. baseline_below_zero and baseline_tie use that same population. These baselines expose support differences; they are not additional validation measurements.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:perturbed_margin: Perturbed positive-minus-fixed-negative margin on the same successful tuples as baseline_margin; draws averaged within user, then users weighted equally.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:draw_coverage: attempted_draws counts the actual persisted variants. supported_draws plus unavailable_draws must equal attempted_draws. unavailable_draws_by_reason includes failures for users with other successful draws; unavailable_users_by_reason counts only users with no successful draws, grouping their distinct failure reasons.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:margin_delta: Perturbed minus intact margin for identical target and negative; draws averaged within user before averaging users.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:absolute_margin_delta: Absolute perturbed-minus-intact positive-minus-fixed-negative margin, averaged over successful draws within user, then equally over eligible users. This exploratory sensitivity is not an accuracy metric.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:matched_suite: Original panel, final-training targets, fixed negatives and seven original conditions remain unchanged. Require at least two older prefix items; retain latest item. Select k=min(older,max(1,floor(0.25*older))) older positions with digest-seeded isolated RNGs. All matching counts are full-training, hence retrospective. Sorted same-floor(log2(frequency)) pools exclude padding, complete training history including target, fixed negative, original prefix and previous replacements. No bin widening. Any empty pool invalidates the entire substitution draw; partial replacements are never scored. Artifacts report requested and matched counts, selection order, pool sizes, bins, signed log-frequency imbalance and exact support tuples. Matching does not identify causal effects.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:matched_controls: Substitution changes content at fixed occupied positions. Selected permutation shuffles only the selected older positions; whole permutation shuffles all older positions. Both retain latest item, occupied positions and exact item multiset. Permutations may be ineffective, particularly for one selected slot or repeated identities; these draws remain valid and their strength and feasibility are reported. Matched deletion removes the same selected positions and compacts/right-aligns survivors, preserving the latest readout item. It changes content, context and positions together. Identity uses unchanged inputs. No zero-item interior holes are introduced.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:common_support: older_substitution and common_* controls use identical successful user/draw/position tuples. Unprefixed permutation/deletion controls retain their broader original matched-suite eligibility; compare them descriptively. Means first average successful draws within users, then weight users equally; a user with one successful draw has the same user weight as one with five. Eligible IDs, attempted/supported draws and failed coverage are reported. Original seven-condition eligibility is unchanged.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:optional_controls: Temporal matching and explicit-position deletion controls are unavailable, rather than approximated. No architecture adapter, unchanged-input feature/score fidelity test, padding-key visibility verification or modified-masking baseline is supplied. Existing position-control nulls remain authoritative. Unchanged-history repetition checks float32 audit features and margins, not separate positive/negative score fidelity; it does not verify an explicit-position adapter.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:prospective_pilot: No reference fitting, validation-linked sensitivity or sensitivity–deltaHR association is measured here. A future pilot must freeze baseline/last-item/additive-half-life-10 references, seed-42 shared fitting protocol, computation/query caps and comparisons before fitting; use the pinned validation users/candidates and host macro HR@10 selection. Log all comparisons and report common-support counts. Conditional user bootstrap intervals neither capture training-seed variation nor correct adaptive validation exposure. Native twenty-training-user full-catalog recommendations remain the host simulator's separate responsibility.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:ordering_flip: Fraction of user/draw pairs for which margin>0 changes truth value. Exact ties are nonpositive and reported separately.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:feature_cosine_distance: 1-cosine between intact and perturbed final features; zero-norm pairs excluded. eligible_users reports metric-specific coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:deletion: For n>=2 remove min(n-1,max(1,floor(0.25*n))) newest, oldest, or uniformly sampled positions. Compact survivors in order. Content, context, and absolute positions can change together; persisted deletion indices refer to retained-prefix positions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:shuffle: Permute nonpadding IDs only, preserving multiplicities, targets and candidate IDs. Timestamp slots stay fixed. keep_latest excludes the newest slot from both swap roles.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:availability_shuffle: Window-restricted adaptation: minima computed over complete public training histories. Freeze all occurrences at their item's minimum timestamp, including ties. Scan unfrozen slots chronologically and uniformly choose feasible unfrozen partners j>=i with both swapped items available at destination times. Self-swaps allowed. Not a reproduction of complete-history author shuffling; training minima approximate availability, not release dates.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:swap_statistics: Displacement is fraction of original slots with changed item ID; repeated IDs can hide swaps. eligible_partner_mean averages feasible partner counts over attempted slots. nonself_swap_rate divides nonself swaps by attempted slots. No attempted slots gives null, not zero. Deletion displacement is undefined.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:uncertainty: 1000 seed-42 user-cluster percentile bootstrap replicates of user-averaged measurements when >=20 eligible users. Conditional on fixed panel, candidates and fitted model; excludes training seed variation and search bias. No cross-checkpoint trajectory comparison or calibrated health threshold is claimed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:aggregation: This result is per dataset. aggregate_diagnoses requires all four named datasets and computes equal-weight macro means only where all four provide a measurement; it does not pool users or p10 values.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:unavailable: Null plus reason denotes empty or unsupported evidence. Item categories, ratings, prices, stores, review text and simulator traits are unavailable and unused. No larger-candidate ranks, top-10 overlaps, full-catalog quality or simulator conclusions are measured.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:state_isolation: Active loader is never iterated or inspected. Panel and permutations are persisted independently; local RNGs only. Global RNGs, explicit generators in view/model fields and standard containers, heterogeneous module modes and registered buffers are protected. Buffer mutation is restored and rejected. Identical intervention batches reuse measurements within a checkpoint, requiring deterministic eval forwards. Arbitrary Python-side mutations, custom stochastic eval behavior and generators hidden inside arbitrary objects are outside this adapter's guarantee.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:verification_limit: Enabled-versus-disabled subsequent optimizer-step equivalence has not been empirically tested here. No training or validation improvement is claimed. Diagnostic calls are host scheduled; no checkpoint-trajectory inference is made.

metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:uncertainty: 1000 seed-42 user-cluster percentile bootstrap replicates of user-averaged measurements when >=20 eligible users. Conditional on fixed panel, candidates and fitted model; excludes training seed variation and search bias. No cross-checkpoint trajectory comparison or calibrated health threshold is claimed.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:aggregation: This result is per dataset. aggregate_diagnoses requires all four named datasets and computes equal-weight macro means only where all four provide a measurement; it does not pool users or p10 values.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:unavailable: Null plus reason denotes empty or unsupported evidence. Item categories, ratings, prices, stores, review text and simulator traits are unavailable and unused. No larger-candidate ranks, top-10 overlaps, full-catalog quality or simulator conclusions are measured.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:state_isolation: Active loader is never iterated or inspected. Panel and permutations are persisted independently; local RNGs only. Global RNGs, explicit generators in view/model fields and standard containers, heterogeneous module modes and registered buffers are protected. Buffer mutation is restored and rejected. Identical intervention batches reuse measurements within a checkpoint, requiring deterministic eval forwards. Arbitrary Python-side mutations, custom stochastic eval behavior and generators hidden inside arbitrary objects are outside this adapter's guarantee.
metric_definitions.CDs_and_Vinyl:verification_limit: Enabled-versus-disabled subsequent optimizer-step equivalence has not been empirically tested here. No training or validation improvement is claimed. Diagnostic calls are host scheduled; no checkpoint-trajectory inference is made.

compaction.policy: preserve top-level metric names; cap nested raw examples, never fabricate measurements
